title: Seven Stars API
description: An API for the Middle-earth Mod and affiliated addons by the Seven Stars Studio
body:
-----

Seven Stars API

This mod is designed purely for the Middle-earth project and it's addons made by the Seven Stars Studio
It's a library used for devs to manipulate entities behaviors with the new Brain class by Mojang. More dev features will be added later on.


This mod is a dependency for the Middle-earth mod, which you can find it here. ----- ## Credits
